name: Function calling
summary: Tools are defined in code as functions with a JSON Schema or typed input. They are passed to the model's tool-calling API, and the harness runs whichever function the model picks.
how: Write each tool as a function with a name, description and typed input
Send the tool definitions with each model request
The model replies with a tool call: a tool name and JSON arguments
The harness validates the arguments, runs the function and returns the result
Repeat until the model answers without calling a tool
facts: AI SDK (tool()), OpenAI Agents SDK (function tools), LangChain and LangGraph (@tool, ToolNode), Mastra (createTool)
No server or protocol to run, but tools are tied to one codebase and harness
goodFor: Tools that only one agent needs
Keeping tool code, types and tests next to the agent
watchOut: Each SDK has its own tool format, so tools don't move between harnesses as-is
Tool definitions are sent with every request and use context
Arguments come from the model, so tools that change data still need checks
